clientProjects.title: Arena
clientProjects.description: A real-time cricket analytics platform built for a client, featuring live ball-by-ball match streaming via SSE, advanced interactive charts (wagon wheel, worm, manhattan, ball-by-ball), detailed scorecards, and player analytics — all in a polished dark-first UI.
clientProjects.fullDescription: Arena is a professional cricket analytics mobile app built for a sports-tech client. It streams live match data using Server-Sent Events from the Opta feed, handling both provisional delivery events (timeline_update) and authoritative score confirmations (scorecard_update). The app features custom-painted cricket visualizations, per-player batting and bowling analytics, playing XI lineups, and a multi-tab dashboard — delivering a comprehensive match experience for cricket fans.
userHighlights: Follow live cricket matches ball-by-ball with instant delivery animations, pitch maps, and provisional scoring that updates to authoritative Opta data within seconds.
Explore interactive charts — wagon wheel, worm chart, manhattan chart, and ball-by-ball runs — to understand batting patterns and match momentum at a glance.
View detailed scorecards with batting figures, bowling stats, fall of wickets, shot types, and fielding positions for every player.
Browse the full playing XI lineup with player cards and career stats before and during a match.
Switch between English and Spanish, and toggle light/dark mode from the profile settings.
Navigate a clean 5-tab dashboard covering live match center, schedule, search, and profile.
developerHighlights: Implemented dual SSE event processing (timeline_update for immediate animations, scorecard_update for authoritative scores) with a lifecycle-aware connection manager that pauses on background and resumes on foreground.
Built a custom-painter chart system with an extensible base architecture powering wagon wheel, worm, manhattan, and ball-by-ball visualizations without third-party charting libraries.
Structured as a monorepo with six local packages (routing, flavor, locale, local_storage, common_components, network) to enforce separation of concerns and enable independent testing.
Applied Riverpod + StateNotifier state management with plain Dart copyWith() state classes — no code generation — for fast iteration and readable state transitions.
Integrated a Dio interceptor chain with automatic token refresh on 401, graceful force-logout on refresh failure, and functional Either<Exception, T> error handling throughout the data layer.
Configured multi-flavor builds (staging/production) with separate entry points, environment configs, and a draggable Talker debug overlay available only in staging.
features: Real-time live match streaming via Server-Sent Events (flutter_client_sse) with ball-by-ball delivery events from Opta.
Pitch map visualization with delivery coordinates, shot type, connection quality, foot movement, and field position.
Wagon wheel shot distribution chart and worm/manhattan/ball-by-ball run charts rendered with custom Flutter painters.
Detailed scorecard: per-player batting and bowling figures, fall of wickets, dismissal info, and extras breakdown.
Playing XI lineup display with player stats cards and team player selection interface.
Mini scorecard carousel and match schedule browser with venue details.
User profile with editable details, theme switching (light/dark), and bilingual support (EN/ES).
Authentication with OTP verification, JWT token refresh interceptor, and auto-logout on session expiry.
5-tab bottom navigation dashboard (Match Center as default landing tab) with IndexedStack for tab state persistence.
Multi-flavor build configuration (staging/production) with environment-specific base URLs and debug tooling.

personalProjects.title: Lend Mate
personalProjects.description: A fintech P2P loan management app with EMI scheduling, Supabase backend, payment proof & lender approval workflow, extra-payment recalculation, and GitHub Actions CI/CD that auto-builds an APK to Google Drive on every push to main.
personalProjects.fullDescription: LendMate is a peer-to-peer loan tracking app built to help individuals manage personal loans with transparency between borrower and lender. The app supports loan creation, EMI scheduling, proof-based payment approvals, extra payments, reminders, and complete payment history so both parties can always see the latest loan status. A GitHub Actions pipeline automatically builds and uploads the APK to Google Drive on every push to main.
userHighlights: Create and manage personal loans with amount, interest rate, tenure, EMI date, and start date.
View separate dashboards for loans you borrowed and loans you lent.
Track EMI status, next due date, remaining balance, and completed payments in one place.
Mark EMIs as paid, upload payment proof, and wait for lender approval for transparent reconciliation.
Make extra payments and choose whether they reduce total interest or reduce loan tenure.
Store optional UPI IDs for borrower and lender to simplify repayment coordination.
developerHighlights: Structured around a layered Flutter architecture with models, repositories, BLoC/Cubit state management, and feature-based UI modules.
Uses Supabase for backend services, Supabase Auth for authentication, and Supabase Storage for payment proof uploads.
Implements EMI calculations, dynamic repayment updates, and extra payment recalculation logic for reducing tenure or interest impact.
GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline automatically builds the APK and uploads it to Google Drive on every push to main.
Supports real-time sync for loan and payment status so both parties stay updated without manual refresh cycles.
features: Loan creation with principal, annual interest, tenure, EMI date, start date, borrower selection, and optional UPI IDs.
Automatic EMI, total interest, and total repayment amount calculation.
Dual-role experience where one user can be a lender in one loan and a borrower in another.
Borrower payment workflow with screenshot proof upload and lender-side approval.
EMI tracking with pending, paid, and approved states plus next due date visibility.
Complete payment history with proof records and filtering by time period.
Reminder and notification flow for due EMIs, approvals, and extra payments.
Dashboard summary for borrowed amount, lent amount, upcoming payments, and overall repayment visibility.
GitHub Actions CI/CD: automatic APK build and Google Drive upload on push to main.
